The MTT Droid Fighter was a small fightercraft that could be deployed from within the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTT]] to attack [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ground forces. To accomplish this, the vehicle boasted two rocket launchers that could either be installed on the wingtips for a wide angle of attack or on the mounting point at the back of the main body for a more focused attack. Unlike most of the other starfighters utilized by the Trade Federation and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], the starfighter was itself not a droid, but rather piloted by a [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]. The droid was seated in a fully enclosed cockpit within the main body.<ref name="Hasbro" />
